text: げんきだと　うまく　とれないかも

structure.jp: うまく　とれないかも
structure.en: you might not be able to catch it well

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain statement means 'if' or 'whenever' that is so, the next thing follows. げんきだと = 'if it's healthy'.

patterns.name: 〜かもしれない
patterns.explanation: かも is the short spoken form of かもしれない, 'maybe'. とれないかも = 'you might not be able to catch it'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: とる 'take' becomes とれる 'can take', and ない makes it 'cannot'. とれない = 'can't catch it'.
